plan-hard.description: Hardest architecture and debugging questions only. Small monthly quota on Go: use rarely.

build-hard.description: Tricky implementation the main build agent could not solve. Small monthly quota: use rarely.

frontend.description: Routine React screens (Ops, Control Room, Mini App) with Arabic RTL and English. Never touches payment, deposit or authentication code.

frontend-hard.description: Hard UI sessions only (complex layouts, POS screen). Very small quota: use rarely.

tests.description: Writes tests from the spec and acceptance criteria. Must be a different model than the one that wrote the code.

bulk.description: Boilerplate, repetitive edits, CI fixes and log triage.

docs.description: Drafts documentation, SOPs and commit messages with a free model. Never give it secrets, credentials or real customer data.

arabic.description: Drafts Arabic UI strings and Arabic SOPs. A native Egyptian speaker must review every string.

ui-check.description: Looks at screenshots (including Arabic right-to-left) and reports layout problems. Read-only.

review-by-glm.description: Read-only reviewer for code written by DeepSeek or Kimi. The author never reviews its own code.

review-by-deepseek.description: Read-only reviewer for code written by GLM. The author never reviews its own code.
